위성영상·공개문서에 근거한 연구 추정입니다. 공식 접속신청·계약·통전 승인 원장이 아닙니다. 일부 건물 운영은 전체 캠퍼스 완공을 뜻하지 않습니다.
용량은 Epoch가 모델링한 가동 단계의 IT/시설 전력입니다. 요청·계약 용량이나 전체 캠퍼스 설계용량이 아니므로 phase 범위로 분리하고 캠퍼스 용량 가중 분모에 합산하지 않습니다.
이 수집기는 예정일·통상 공사기간 경과만으로 추정한 운영을 실제 운영 단계로 승격하지 않습니다. 원문의 추정 설명과 과거 기준일은 근거에 보존합니다.
일부 건물의 운영이 확인돼도 전체 캠퍼스 완료나 다섯 요건 통과로 바꾸지 않습니다. 검토한 부분 운영은 날짜와 근거를 기록하고 공사·증설 단계로 보수 평가합니다.
원문 주소: Amazon Data Services Inc, Madison Mega Site Nissan Parkway and Highway 22 Canton, Mississippi Madison County

In the Duke faciltiy in nearby Mississippi, several natural gas turbines are in place but not fully connected up.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2025-10-19. 원문: Battery facility looks complete (though more might be added). Turbines look connected up, minimal construction around them. We believe this state corresponds to the first compute cluster brought online at this site of "approximately 110,000 GB200 processors, approximately 210 megawatts of compute power", as detailed in the [company S-1 filing, page 76](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026036936/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm). Based on those numbers, we believe "compute power" corresponds to GPU server power. [Earlier](https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1947715674429919279) [tweets](https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1950251710141567110) from Elon Musk also support this timing, and it's consistent with the estimated cooling capacity based on the satellite image.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-01-13. 원문: Since October, an array of dry cooling air-cooled condensers has been added (the array of large fans to the left of the building), and appears almost complete. Two more similar arrays appear to be under construction. More air-cooled chillers, batteries, and gas turbines have also been installed.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-04-06. 원문: The first array of dry cooling air-cooled condensers for Building 1 has been completed and is operational. A second array, with larger fans, is about halfway complete (located to the south of the first array). More chillers have also been added. For Building 2, an array of dry cooling air-cooled condensers of the same type as Building 1's first array is beginning construction. We believe this corresponds to the "second cluster of 110,000 GB300 processors and 220 megawatts of compute power" from the [company S-1 filing, page 76](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026036936/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm), with compute power corresponding to GPU server power. This is also consistent with our estimates based on cooling equipment.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-06-15. 원문: The site is estimated to have at least ~830 MW of GPU server power, with at least "at least 220,000 additional GB300 processors and over 400 additional megawatts of compute power", corresponding to the "next phase of expansion" found in the following [company S-1 filing, page 76](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026036936/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm). This estimate is backed up by our cooling and turbine based power production calculations. The cooling calculations suggest there is enough infrastructure to support ~850MW of IT Power. Similarly the energy production calculations support ~900MW of available IT Power. This gives us confidence that the proposed expansion was achieved in time. Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2025-10-01. 검토한 운영 근거: 9월 30일 기준 HPC 전력 가동을 명시한 TeraWulf 발표를 근거로 한 10월 1일의 일부 운영 상태입니다. 정확한 통전 개시일은 아닙니다. 원문: Building 1 is operational. Based on Terawulf [saying](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/126/terawulf-reports-third-quarter-2025-results) "As of September 30, 2025, the site has energized 245 MW of Bitcoin-mining capacity and 22.5 MW of HPC capacity." The small "Wulf Den" building was [said](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/99/terawulf-to-deliver-over-70-mw-of-data-center) to be 2 MW of IT power while CB-1 would be 16 MW. This is roughly consistent with 22.5 MW of total facility power. This building is [leased](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/99/terawulf-to-deliver-over-70-mw-of-data-center) to Core42, a subsidiary of UAE-based G42. It likely uses NVIDIA DGX B200 servers.

It likely uses NVIDIA DGX B200 servers.

This is based on the expansion of the dry cooling array from 4 to 7 columns (seen on [Google Earth](https://earth.google.com/web/@39.4948785,-119.43174359,1568.8659293a,562.69639351d,35y,-0h,0t,0r/)). Buildings 7-11 all have some kind of power or cooling equipment lining their right side which are not fully installed. Building 14 has chillers installed. Buildings 16-20 roofs are complete. The Socrates South power plant to the right of Buildings 7-11 has 7 gas turbines in place, judging by the exhaust stacks.

Northern tents (Buildings 16-27) are all roofed except for 21 and 27.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-08-31. 검토한 운영 근거: 당일 열영상에서 7~10번 건물의 밝은 배기구와 남측 전원 가동을 관측했습니다. 북측 건물과 13번 건물은 운영 완료로 판단하지 않습니다. 원문: Buildings 7-10 (tents) are operational, based on infrared drone video from RAAD (raad.com) captured on this date. The video suggests that 138.8 MW of nameplate turbine capacity is operating at the Socrates South power plant (about 69% of the 200 MW nameplate capacity), and Buildings 7-10 roof vents are bright on infrared while Buildings 11-12 vents are not. That's 4/6 buildings operating, implying about 67% of capacity, which is consistent with 69% of the power plant operating. In the north, Buildings 16-27 (tents) look to be in a completed state. Each northern set of 6 tents still awaits to be connected to one of the corresponding power plants to become operational. Drone video from August 19th shows no turbines operating at Socrates North, though there are 3 small diesel generators operating. Building 13 (Vantage) is still under construction, we estimate another 3 months before operability.

We estimate Building 1 became operational around early 2026 with about 50 MW of IT capacity (70 MW total facility power at a 1.4 PUE), based on DataOne's disclosure of a first 50 MW phase. SemiAnalysis estimated the full 50 MW was reached around January to February 2026 ([SemiAnalysis](https://newsletter.semianalysis.com/p/stop-saying-half-of-2026-us-datacenter)); this April image is our first high-resolution confirmation that the cooling is in place.

We therefore keep IT capacity at 50 MW.

OpenAI [stated](https://openai.com/index/five-new-stargate-sites/) that "Oracle began delivering the first NVIDIA GB200 racks in June." The "tenant improvement" work [is not due](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2025000156) until September, however.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2025-09-26. 검토한 운영 근거: Crusoe가 첫 단계를 live로 발표한 9월 30일을 사용합니다. 원문 행의 추정일 9월 26일이나 전체 건물 완공을 운영 사건으로 기록하지 않습니다. 원문: Building 1 is fully operational around this date. The first phase was "live" on September 30 according a Crusoe [announcement](https://www.crusoe.ai/resources/newsroom/crusoe-announces-flagship-abilene-data-center-is-live). While the first phase consists of Building 1 and 2, the language doesn't outright confirm that both buildings are fully operational. The announcement also stated that "Oracle began delivering the first NVIDIA GB200 racks in June", and we think 3 months is enough time to ram to 50,000 GB200s in Building 1. The satellite image also suggests that Building 1 is complete (shell and equipment done, many cars neatly parked) while Building 2 is ongoing (trucks and construction equipment still present). The 200 MW [substation](https://www.mortenson.com/projects/abilene-data-center-development) built in 2022 and expanded in 2024 is enough to power both buildings. To the right of Building 2, five gas turbines are in place with five more turbines still under construction. Chillers are partly installed for Building 3. Roof is complete for Building 4. The larger 1 GW substation is not complete yet.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-01-15. 원문: The 1 GW substation looks close to completion. Building 3 appears to have all power and cooling equipment installed, but there are still signs of construction work. This seems on track for operation in 3 months. Building 4 has about 80% of chillers installed. Other buildings have few or no chillers installed.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-03-24. 원문: Building 3 and 4 look complete, but are not fully operational. Not as many cars are parked next to it as Building 1-2 which suggests they may still be ramping up. Building 4 was due by now according to a [regulatory filing](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2025014756). Building 5 still has light construction activity, while Building 6 still lacks chillers. The on-site power plant to the right of Building 2 looks complete.

Epoch AI의 시설 관측/판단을 재분류한 상태입니다. 공식 계통 승인·통전 증거가 아닙니다. 원문 행 날짜: 2026-05-23. 원문: Buildings 3 and 4 are estimated to be operational. On April 22nd, Oracle [posted](https://x.com/i/status/2047012589302153558) that "In Abilene, 200MW is already operational". This suggests that there was still only Building 1 and 2 operational. Since Buildings 3 and 4 looked complete from the outside on March 24th, we give it another month after Oracle's post for them to be operational. This would also give the buildings a similar 1 year 4 months timeline that Buildings 1 took from land clearing to being operational.
